summary: P2 iteration full-stack test of KinoKontroll. Backend: 28/28 pytest tests pass — 17 pre-existing tests (auth, video CRUD, range stream, WS auth/broadcast) all still green, plus 11 new P2 tests covering /api/state per-room, /api/rooms listing, multi-room WS isolation (sal-A vs sal-B), 'ended' action no-auth advance + stop-at-end + stale-id rejection, and thumbnail upload/fetch + has_thumbnail flag. Frontend: landing 'Sal / Skjerm' input updates nav targets to /display/<room> & /control/<room> (with sanitization to lowercase alphanumeric + dash/underscore); /control/sal-1 header shows 'sal: sal-1' via control-room-label testid; /display/sal-1 and /display/sal-2 each connect to ?room=<room> WS endpoints (verified via captured ws urls) and stay isolated; sonner toast 'Ikke autorisert — logg inn på nytt' surfaces correctly when WS sends an action with an invalid token (verified by clearing localStorage token and clicking next). Lifespan startup runs cleanly — backend log shows 'Storage initialized'. Display.jsx wires v.addEventListener('ended', onEnded) → sendPublic({action:'ended', video_id}) (code-verified; cannot be visually triggered without a real playable video in headless).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~675 lines and mixes auth, storage, video CRUD, streaming, room state, and the WebSocket endpoint. Recommend splitting into modules (routers/auth.py, routers/videos.py, routers/state.py, ws/manager.py) before it grows further.

list_rooms() returns rooms only from playback_state collection; rooms with active WS connections but no persisted state would not appear. Acceptable today since get_state_doc auto-inserts on connect, but document this contract.
Thumbnail size cap is 4 MB (line 233) — fine for client-captured JPEGs, but no MIME validation beyond ext sniffing; consider rejecting non-image content_types explicitly.

WebSocket endpoint accepts every connection then gates per-message; an unauthenticated client can keep a socket open and receive state broadcasts — that is intentional for /display, but be aware it permits passive eavesdropping of room state by anyone who knows the room slug.

_normalize_room strips characters silently — sending room='Sal 1' becomes 'sal1', not 'sal-1'. Frontend sanitizes the same way so it lines up, but a mismatch would silently merge rooms. Consider returning the normalized id back to the client on connect.
captureThumbnail in Upload.jsx is best-effort and silent; if it fails (codec/CORS) the user has no signal. Minor — acceptable per spec, but a debug console.warn would help.
useSync re-creates the WebSocket on every `room` change but the toast throttle is 1.5s shared across rooms; OK in practice.
